source: lab (captured; background replaced by flat green with SAM2 - 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' watermark bottom-right)

camera.motion: static (background is uniform green, but the catcher's feet/shoes stay at the same pixels (bbox_y1 = 437, x0 = 924) in all frames, so no pan/shake)

intrinsics_lab_convention.note: Orbbec Femto Mega, HFOV 80 deg, f = 0.5959*1280

camera.perspective: No floor, wall or horizon visible (green background). Depth cues only from apparent size: ball circle radius shrinks from ~64 px (in thrower's hands, near camera) to ~31-34 px (in catcher's hands, far). Catcher's shoes at image y ~385-437 mark her floor contact; camera is looking down slightly (catcher's figure is foreshortened / leaning in image).

ball.description: white soccer ball with black pentagons and a black 'Franklin'-style logo, the only ball; thrown from the near person (left) to the far person (right)
ball.reference_point: visible ball centre (x,y): circle fit to the ball outline; frames 27-36 (motion blur) use the centroid of the blurred ball blob

thrower.description: near person at the left edge, light grey T-shirt, dark trousers, glasses, face blurred; holds the ball at waist then throws underhand with both arms
thrower.visible_frames: 0-48 (always truncated by left and bottom image edges; only torso/arms/head-side visible)
thrower.reference_point: centroid of visible mask (pelvis not visible)

catcher.description: far person at the right, dark grey short-sleeve shirt, black trousers with white drawstrings, white sneakers, long hair, face blurred; head cut by the top image edge
catcher.moves: stands in place; arms move to catch (from ~frame 36), ball held in front of her waist after frame 42

static_extents_px.note: top of head is above the frame (mask touches y=0), so 438 px is a lower bound on full body height; shoes at x~925-1010, y~378-437

events.name: ball held by thrower, small wind-up sway
events.detail: ball centre rises from y 546 (f0) to y 518 (f13-15), then dips to lowest y 604 at frame 24 (wind-up)

events.name: throw (forward/upward swing) starts
events.detail: ball starts moving right/up; strong blur from frame 27

events.name: release (last hand contact)
events.detail: hand touches ball in 31, clear gap in 32; release between frames 31 and 32 (~1.31 s)

events.name: image-space apex of ball (minimum y)
events.detail: y within 1 px over frames 37-38; true 3D apex not resolved

events.name: ball secured and carried down to waist
